title: Transfer Function and Stability Analysis of a Feedback System with Delay
expert_review: Excellent problem for bridging the gap between continuous-time transfer functions and discrete-time-like behavior caused by delays.
learning_objectives: Derive transfer functions for systems with delay elements
Utilize geometric series to transform s-domain expressions to time-domain series
Apply the impulse response integral criterion to determine asymptotic stability
Understand the impact of feedback gain on the stability of delayed systems
